data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for Android and iOS for sharing text, images, videos, and files.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to invoke the platform's native share UI to send text, images, videos, audio, and general files. Supports single items as well as multiple files.
use_when: You need to share text, media, or files from your app to other apps using the native system UI.
You want support for sharing multiple images or files at once.
avoid_when: You require custom in-app sharing implementations rather than the native system sheet.
strengths: Supports multiple file and image sharing.
Includes options for Android share panel title and subject lines.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of platform-specific permissions like Info.plist or AndroidManifest.xml.
Older plugin that depends on external setup steps for storage/photo library access.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription to iOS Info.plist and READ/WRITE external storage permissions in AndroidManifest.xml for handling external storage files.
